01 — How it works

On your site in three moves.

No training sessions and no flow charts to draw. It works from what you have already written.

  1. Point it at your website

    Give it your address and it reads your pages. Add PDFs, Word files or pasted text for anything the site does not say.

  2. Ask it what your customers ask

    Talk to it on a preview page before anyone else does. A wrong answer is fixed in your content, not in a prompt.

  3. Paste one line of code

    Copy the snippet into your site. The chat takes your site's colours and font by itself, and only works on the sites you list.

02 — What it does

Built to hand you customers, not transcripts.

Every conversation is kept, every lead is listed, and every question it could not answer becomes your next piece of content.

01

Leads with a name attached

Visitors leave an email or a phone number in the chat, typed or through a short form. You get a list, and a CSV export.

02

It says when it does not know

No invented prices or policies. It offers a follow-up instead, and you keep your visitor's trust.

03

See what it could not answer

Every unanswered question is listed, so you always know what to add next.

04

It looks like your website

A new bot reads your site's styles and takes its brand colour and font, with readable text on any colour.

05

Your choice of AI

A low-cost model by default. Or connect your own key from DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, and your messages are not capped.

06

Every site in one place

One login holds several bots, each locked to its own website, with its own content, leads and open questions.

05 — Questions

Questions people ask first.

Does it make things up?

It answers from the content you give it. When the answer is not there, it says so and offers to have someone follow up, instead of guessing at prices or policies.

What can it learn from?

Your website (it can crawl it for you), individual pages, PDF and Word files, plain text files, and anything you paste in. You can add, replace or remove each source at any time.

Which AI does it use?

By default it runs on a low-cost model chosen by the platform. You can also connect your own key from DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, and messages on your own key are not capped.

Will it slow my website down?

The widget is one small script that loads after your page. It lives in its own isolated container, so it cannot change how your site looks, and your site's styles cannot break it.

Can I run bots for several clients?

Yes. One account holds several bots, each locked to its own website, with its own content, leads and insights.

How do I pay for a paid plan?

There is no online checkout yet. Start on Free. When you need more, book a consultation and the ZEHNOX team moves you to a paid plan and arranges billing with you directly.
